about: Front matter (Obsidian's properties block) as three copies read it: the reading view hides it (notes/render/obsidian.ts stripFrontmatter), the native parser lists its properties and tags (markdown/frontmatter.rs through pulldown-cmark), and the browser stand-in (notes/noteDoc.ts standInNoteDoc) answers in Playwright. Obsidian is the answer key. `hidden`: the block is not shown as text. `tags`: the front matter's tags ([] when there is no block). TypeScript rows: src/notes/frontmatterContract.test.ts; Rust rows: vaultdraw-core/tests/frontmatter_contract.rs. `drift` names the copies that disagree today, with the toimprove number (bug hunter J, 2026-10-30).
